why: The Aerodrome Road / Watford Way lights: the short unnamed link across the central reservation, from Aerodrome Road to Greyhound Hill; the route planner will not route through short unnamed ways, so ahead over Watford Way was not possible.

Bristol Avenue's short one-way link down on to Grahame Park Way (westbound) has a contraflow bus lane beside it (busway:right=opposite_lane): mapped as one lane, the scene drew it 3.2 m wide, too narrow to turn out of on to Grahame Park Way without cutting the kerb.

Lismore Boulevard's 10 m stub off Aerodrome Road, west of Heritage Avenue: beyond it the road is private (access=private, left out of the scene), so the stub led nowhere and background cars turned into it and stood parked across its mouth, in the car's lane on Aerodrome Road.
